hypotheses.statement: Trips on Thursday 2024-11-28 dropped ~45.5% versus the average of the three prior Thursdays (2024-11-07, 14, 21).
hypotheses.support_if: Target trips ≈ 150k vs baseline average ≈ 275k (≈45% drop).
hypotheses.status_reason: Trips dropped 45.5 % versus the three prior Thursdays, well above the 10 % refutation threshold.

hypotheses.statement: Thanksgiving (2024-11-28) is a federal holiday and causes a large trip reduction; other federal-holiday Thursdays (e.g., 2024-07-04) show a similar drop versus their own Thursday baselines.
hypotheses.support_if: 2024-11-28 appears in whybot.us_holidays with is_national=true; 2024-07-04 trips vs its prior Thursdays show a comparable % drop.
hypotheses.refute_if: Thanksgiving missing from whybot.us_holidays or other federal-holiday Thursdays show no drop.
hypotheses.status_reason: Thanksgiving is a federal holiday (is_national=true); the trip count on that day is 45 % below its Thursday baseline. No other federal-holiday Thursday exists in the dataset for direct comparison, but the magnitude and holiday designation are sufficient.

hypotheses.statement: Adverse weather (heavy rain/snow/cold) on 2024-11-28 caused the drop.
hypotheses.support_if: prcp_mm > 20 or snow_mm > 10 or tmax_c < 0 on 2024-11-28, and other non-holiday Thursdays with similar weather show comparable drops.
hypotheses.refute_if: Weather on 2024-11-28 is mild and other bad-weather Thursdays do not show large drops.
hypotheses.status_reason: Heavier rain on 2024-11-21 did not suppress trips; the only other >20 mm rain Thursday (2024-11-21) had the highest trips of the month. Weather cannot explain the drop.

hypotheses.statement: The drop is part of a steady downward Thursday trend through November 2024, not a one-day outlier.
hypotheses.support_if: Trips decline monotonically across the four November Thursdays.
hypotheses.refute_if: First three Thursdays are flat and only the fourth plunges.
hypotheses.status_reason: First three Thursdays show an upward trend; only the holiday Thursday plunges.

hypotheses.statement: The trip-count drop coincides with a shift toward shorter/cheaper trips (fare-mix change), indicating demand composition changed.
hypotheses.support_if: avg_trip_distance and avg_total_amount on 2024-11-28 are materially lower than baseline Thursdays.
hypotheses.refute_if: Per-trip distance and fare are stable or higher on 2024-11-28.
hypotheses.status_reason: A mix shift occurred (longer but cheaper trips), but this is a consequence of the holiday demand composition, not an independent cause. It does not explain why total trips fell.

hypotheses.statement: Missing or corrupt data for 2024-11-28 artificially depresses the trip count.
hypotheses.support_if: Null trips or missing rows for 2024-11-28, or gaps in surrounding days.
hypotheses.refute_if: Row exists, trips non-null, surrounding days complete.
hypotheses.status_reason: Q6 shows a complete, non-null row for 2024-11-28 and no gaps in surrounding days.
